reason: I already have a bottle I use every day, and hotel tap water is only a problem a few times a year. Sixty-eight bucks up front plus a filter subscription for that is hard to justify, and 5% off barely counts as a deal.
objection: I'd be paying for a whole new bottle and signing up for recurring filters when the bottle I own works fine. $12.99 shipping on the bottle alone is a dealbreaker, so they're basically pushing me into a subscription.
would_change_my_mind: A real discount, like 20-25% off the starter bundle, or a filter that fits my existing bottle so I'm not buying a whole new one.
